_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Flat 30d price, F&G near 50 and neutral funding keep the coil intact; dead ETF flows lean soft but fed liquidity and two-way misses block a clean break.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly HOLDs toward Complacency; narrative supplies no forward phase or direction
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G stays 45-55 and BTC 30d change remains near flat while ETF flows stay suppressed
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks below 39 with momentum dump and rising exchange inflows, or F&G reclaims above 62 with ETF flows turning positive
